nodes.label: IP-Merging for Math Reasoning in MLLMs
nodes.rationale: Proposes IP-Merging method to transfer math reasoning abilities from specialized LLMs to multimodal LLMs through parameter identification and projection without tuning

nodes.label: Model Merging
nodes.rationale: Technique to integrate task-specific knowledge from multiple fine-tuned models into a single model without requiring training data or intensive computation

nodes.label: IP-Merging Method
nodes.rationale: Tuning-free approach that identifies reasoning-associated parameters, projects them into MLLM subspace, and merges them to transfer math reasoning from specialized LLMs

nodes.label: MathVista Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Benchmark for evaluating multimodal mathematical reasoning across five subsets: FQA, GPS, MWP, TQA, and VQA

nodes.label: MathVerse Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Benchmark with diverse math problems requiring reasoning over textual and visual information including charts, diagrams, and equations
